_help: Act 2, the caravanserai: hiring Farid Mansour, the caravan merchant (hired_farid). 40, or 20 if he may trade along the way (farid_trading). He brings his own stores (rations). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: farid
already.line: Everything is counted twice. Shall I count it a third time?

first.speaker: farid
first.line: Farid Mansour. I move goods between Cairo and twelve towns that are not on your map. You want a road; I sell roads.

choices.label: Hire him
choices.line: I need someone who can keep an expedition fed and moving.

supplies.speaker: farid
supplies.line: Water, fodder, flour, camels, tents. Hire me and my stores travel with you, at a better price than any bazaar.

fee.speaker: farid
fee.line: Forty pounds. Or twenty, if you let me trade along the way. My goods travel with your expedition.

choices.label: Pay the full price
choices.line: Forty. Your business is your own.

choices.label: Let him trade
choices.line: Twenty, and you can trade as we go.

joined.speaker: farid
joined.line: A pleasure doing business. My stores are yours, within reason.
